1.1 Hospital does not use any narcotic drugs, if required patient is referred to higher centre

7.0 OBJECTIVES ELEMENTS

7.1 Documented procedures guide the use of formulations containing toxic/narcotic drugs.

7.2 These procedures are in consonance with local and national regulations.

7.3 These drugs are stored in a secure manner.

7.4 A proper record is kept of the usage, administration and disposal of these drugs.

7.5 These drugs are handled by appropriate personnel in accordance with the documented procedure
